hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeler in Inver Grove Heights for Design and Build
hero.subheadline: McDonald Remodeling has designed and built kitchens, bathrooms and lower levels for Minneapolis, St. Paul and Twin Cities suburb homeowners since 2000. Its designers and craftspeople have earned NARI, Chrysalis and Best of Houzz awards along the way.

image.alt: Bright white kitchen with marble countertops, globe pendants and a window over the sink, by McDonald Remodeling, kitchen remodeler in Inver Grove Heights

intro.h2: Challenging designs, finished down to the last detail
paragraphs: McDonald Remodeling is a kitchen remodeler in Inver Grove Heights founded in 2000 and based on Cahill Avenue. As a full-service design/build firm, it handles both the design and the construction, so one company is responsible for the plan and for the finished room.

The team calls challenging design its specialty, and its featured projects show the range: a mid-century remodel in Minneapolis, a lakeside home on Lake Minnetonka, and a kitchen and main floor rework in a St. Paul home more than 100 years old. Some clients want timeless and quiet; others want green cabinets, bold tile or wallpaper.

services.h2: Kitchens first, then any room that needs a rethink

items.name: Kitchens
items.blurb: From quiet, timeless kitchens to green cabinets and statement tile, the designers plan layout, storage and finishes around how you live. A recent St. Paul project reworked the kitchen and main floor of a 100-plus-year-old home while keeping its historic character.

image.alt: Recrafted kitchen in a 100-year-old St. Paul home with slate blue cabinets, a farmhouse sink, checkerboard tile floor and a wood work table

items.name: Bathrooms
items.blurb: Primary suites, powder rooms and bathrooms made easier to use. McDonald's bath work has earned NARI Contractor of the Year awards in 2022, 2023 and 2024, and one couple hired the team to make a main floor bathroom more accessible as they age.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with a frameless glass door, large light gray tile, a handheld shower and a recessed niche

items.name: Lower levels
items.blurb: Basements become family rooms, guest space or a spot to watch the game. One couple had McDonald finish the basement of their small 1950s house as their first remodeling project and said they were very pleased with the whole process.

image.alt: Finished lower level with a black accent wall, linear fireplace, wood mantel shelf, wall-mounted TV and leather sofa

items.name: Mudrooms, bars and specialty spaces
items.blurb: Specialty rooms get the same design attention: mudrooms with built-in lockers and benches, home bars with glass cabinets and beverage fridges, and cozy dining nooks. These are the places where small details, like a dedicated hutch for coffee mugs, make daily life easier.

image.alt: Mudroom with white oak lockers, a cushioned bench, coat hooks and open storage cubbies

items.name: Whole-home and main-level remodels
items.blurb: When several rooms need work, McDonald plans the main level as a whole, opening up layouts for better flow and connection while keeping the character of older homes. A Bloomington remodel paired a major kitchen upgrade with a living room addition.

image.alt: Dining area with an arched doorway, white oak cabinets and a white pleated pendant over a round wood table

why_choose_us.h2: Why Twin Cities homeowners trust McDonald

items.title: More than 25 years of local work
items.text: Founded in 2000 and based in Inver Grove Heights, the company has served Minneapolis, St. Paul and the surrounding suburbs for over 25 years.

items.title: Awards judged by the industry
items.text: Recent honors include a 2026 Regional Chrysalis Award for a kitchen, 2026 Best of Houzz for Service and Design, and ROMA awards from Housing First Minnesota.

items.title: Schedules you can see
items.text: Deb D. met with Amy almost three years before starting and was shown exactly how scheduling works. Detailed schedules are a recurring theme in the Google reviews.

items.title: Designs for every stage of life
items.text: Clients have hired McDonald to make homes easier to live in as they age, and one family praised a design that removed obstacles for a daughter who uses a wheelchair.

about.h2: Led by owner and CEO Chris Wylie
about.text: Chris Wylie is the owner and CEO of McDonald Remodeling, the design/build firm founded in 2000 and based at 6015 Cahill Avenue East in Inver Grove Heights. The company is a member of NARI and Housing First Minnesota. Its team includes designers such as Alisa Dragt-Hoffman, who favors warm colors and natural materials and will tell you when a design choice isn't quite right. Clients name staff in their reviews, from Amy, who walked Deb D. through scheduling, to Jim, whose patience and knowledge eased one family's worries.

process.h2: How a McDonald project moves from idea to finished room

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Call or use the Connect form. In an early meeting the team explains how the company works, shows how scheduling is set up and shares examples from past projects.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: You work with McDonald's designers on layout, materials, lighting and finishes until the plan fits your space, budget and personal style.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: A project manager and specialists carry out the plan, follow the schedule you reviewed and respond promptly to concerns while respecting your home.

steps.title: Enjoy the finished space
steps.text: The project wraps up against the plan you approved; one Inver Grove Heights couple wrote that their remodel finished on time and within budget.

service_area.h2: Kitchen remodeler in Inver Grove Heights serving the Twin Cities
service_area.text: McDonald Remodeling works from 6015 Cahill Ave E, Suite 100, in Inver Grove Heights and serves Minneapolis, St. Paul and the Twin Cities suburbs. Clients and projects named on its site include Prior Lake, Bloomington, Lake Minnetonka, Minneapolis, St. Paul and Inver Grove Heights itself. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. Call (651) 554-1234 to check whether your home is in range.

items.q: How long has McDonald Remodeling been in business?
items.a: The company was founded in 2000 as a full-service residential design/build firm and is based in Inver Grove Heights. It has served Minneapolis, St. Paul and Twin Cities suburbs for over 25 years, and its Minnesota license number, BC205832, is printed in the footer of every page of its website.

items.q: Does McDonald help with design and selections?
items.a: Yes. As a design/build firm, McDonald handles design as well as construction, and interior design has its own section on the website. Designers such as Alisa Dragt-Hoffman guide finishes, lighting and materials. One client wrote that the design staff and project manager responded promptly to concerns and respected their home.

items.q: Can you make a bathroom or home more accessible?
items.a: Yes. One Google reviewer hired McDonald to remodel a main floor bathroom so it would be more accessible as the couple ages. Another family, whose toddler uses a wheelchair, wrote that the new design removed obstacles and made them feel safe at home. Share any mobility needs at your first meeting.

Recent recognition includes a 2026 Regional Chrysalis Award for a kitchen, 2026 Best of Houzz for both Service and Design, a 2026 Best of the Twin Cities Readers' Poll silver from Mpls. St. Paul Magazine, 2025 and 2024 ROMA awards from Housing First Minnesota, and NARI Contractor of the Year bath awards.

items.q: Can I see finished projects before I commit?
items.a: Yes. The online portfolio is sorted into kitchens, bathrooms, lower levels, living spaces, exteriors and outdoors, and specialty spaces. The blog walks through full before and after case studies, such as the Recrafted Heritage kitchen in St. Paul, and early meetings include examples from other projects.

final_cta.h2: Start the conversation about your kitchen
final_cta.text: Call McDonald Remodeling in Inver Grove Heights or send a note through the Connect form.
